objectives.capacity: maximize validated independent resident full-context slots, subject to all SLOs
objectives.performance: maximize normalized throughput or latency score, subject to minimum capacity and all SLOs

placement: explicit request-serving replicas and physical rank/device map; axes can overlap

capacity_policy.scope: independent full contexts; worst rank per replica
capacity_policy.kv_format_changes: separate fixed-format cohorts with renewed quality/precision qualification
required: unique physical cache pools and actual storage sharding
all-rank peak and admission through all lifecycle phases
independent long-context quality and precision before/after native timing

measurement_policy.throughput: global successful new prefill tokens / full cohort including all attempts and drain
measurement_policy.latency: worst independent-round selected quantile; service TTFT separate from coordinated prefill forward
measurement_policy.communication: per-phase per-rank transmitted wire bytes and matched group/size/algorithm/link references; never sum overlapping time into service latency

small_memory_order: remove actual KV replication with supported storage sharding
reduce duplicated weights using TP/EP/PP budgets
bound chunk workspace, graphs and overlap buffers
verify active offload rather than prefix retention
return infeasible if one complete context does not fit
note: Planner retains this contract; no hardware execution. Offline bundle schema: docs/domains/deployment.md.
